Welcome—let’s step back into a world where the fate of Europe balanced on a knife’s edge, shaped by the tangled lives of three remarkable cousins. Imagine, for a moment, the grand halls and secret chambers where George V of Britain, Nicholas II of Russia, and Wilhelm II of Germany—family by blood, rivals by nature—wove their personal dramas into the very fabric of history.
What if the world’s most powerful empires could be changed by a moment of insecurity, a private rivalry, or a simple misunderstanding? That’s exactly what Miranda Carter uncovers, as she invites us into the hearts and minds of these rulers. Their affections, ambitions, and missteps weren’t just personal—they echoed through the corridors of power, setting off ripples that would swell into the storm of World War I.
Together, we’ll explore this fascinating intersection of family bonds and political intrigue—a place where tradition and modernity collide, and where every decision carries the weight of nations. We’ll see how the drama of George, Nicholas, and Wilhelm’s lives brought early twentieth-century Europe to life, and how their choices sent shockwaves across the globe.
So, as we begin this journey through Miranda Carter’s vivid storytelling, let’s stay curious. Because understanding how the private lives of these royal cousins shaped the destiny of millions just might change the way we see history—and ourselves.
